messages:
elaine: Heads-up — planning a compact 3-part mini-tutorial + reference-app launch for OSS builders. Focus: quick local labs, perf benchmarks, and deploy patterns. Draft plan: https://notion.so/redwood/mini-labs-draft
mike: timeline?
elaine: target publish week of 2026-04-12; webinar 2026-04-15 evening US. Assets needed by 2026-04-01.
tara: I'll lead the benchmark narrative. Thinking: cost/latency charts for quantized models, perf vs seq length, and a short "how we measured" appendix.
samir: I'll handle inbound routing — want a one-click form -> Sales SDR queue + utm tracking. Need final landing copy and funnel events.
jess: I'll write the step-by-step tutorial and refapp README. Plan includes runnable local Docker + a tiny example app. Will base on repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-mini
mike: I'll mock hero screenshots + a GIF of local dev flow. ETA Mar 28.
elaine: docs checklist: tutorial, refapp, benchmark blog, social threads, webinar slide deck, landing page. Assign owners: tutorial=jess, benchmark=tara, design=mike, inbound=samir, comms=elaine.
devrel-bot: Created checklist https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DR-422 with tasks assigned.
jess: Quick sample for README: 
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-mini
cd refapp-mini
docker compose up --build
# open http://localhost:8080 and try the chat flow
```
tara: For benchmarks I'll produce a short table: tokens/sec, p95 latency, cost per 100k tokens for each quantization profile. Also include methodology note about warm-up tokens and batching.
samir: For routing: propose using /lead?source=mini-labs + hidden input 'interest=refapp'. Then Zapier -> HubSpot SDR queue. Anyone object?
mike: No objections. Also will provide alternate hero for dark mode.
elaine: Social copy drafts (short):
- "New: Local Labs — run a tiny refapp that shows how to serve models locally and compare cost & latency. Tutorials + benchmarks. Launching Apr 12. https://redwood.ai/mini-labs"
- "Join our Apr 15 webinar: see a live runthrough + benchmark deep dive. Seats limited. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/mini-labs-webinar"
jess: thumbs up on copy. I'll tweak for a thread-style X post.
tara: I'll add a one-slide explainer about measurement assumptions for the webinar deck.
elaine: Next steps: owners post final drafts into the Notion page by Mar 29. Weekly sync Wed 10am PT starting Mar 20. @mike @tara @jess @samir please confirm.
mike: Confirmed :+1:
tara: Confirmed :+1:
jess: Confirmed :+1:
